race.comment: RASKOL (6) has been at single digit odds at her last three outings but failed to deliver, most recently here at this trip a fortnight ago. The scratchings have turned this into a very modest affair - will not get a better chance to bounce back to form. MISS EMMA (15) led and battled on bravely for a close third over 1200m here last start. Races well at Canterbury and should prove tough to catch coming back to 1100m against this lot. BROWN SUGAR (2) lines up for the first time since late December. Opened the maiden campaign with a couple of wins over 1000m then led the Gosford Guineas field for home before knocking up at the only other appearance. Promising mare who should give a great sight. The lightly raced STUBBORN EMMELIE (14) is back after a four-month spell. Showed ability in the first prep and from a nice gate should get all the favours. The speedy DEE DEE EXPRESS (11) scored at Moruya last time. Finds a tougher assignment today but should be prominent for a long way.
